what: Selected rune-26b-a4b-v3 as sweep-3 candidate from the Vultr catalog; smoke returned HTTP 422: 'Model rune-26b-a4b-v3 is a decision model; use /v1/systemone'. Harness speaks /v1/chat/completions only.
root_cause: Vultr /v1/models catalog does not annotate model types; rune is a decision-model endpoint, not a chat model. Slug was chosen from a priority list made during earlier catalog review without re-verifying endpoint class.
impact: None to data or spend (smoke gate caught it pre-batch, ~$0.003 spent). Sweep-3 slot replaced with glm-5.3 (smoke PASS 1.5s/2.2s).
action_taken: Dropped rune; validated glm-5.3; smoke-gate encoded in chain_sweeps.py so any future slug failure aborts before a sweep starts.
